title: The Prophet Like Moses
lead: Moses promises that God will raise up "a prophet like me" whom Israel must obey (Deuteronomy 18:15–19). The Torah ends by saying no prophet like Moses has yet arisen (Deuteronomy 34:10). Jews have read the promise as the line of true prophets; Samaritans await the Taheb; the Qumran community and many in Jesus' day looked for a coming Prophet (John 1:21; 6:14), and Acts applies the promise to Jesus (Acts 3:22–23; 7:37).
